description: Sample in-bounds ChangeRequests for rest-api-v1 demos (mini-erp-v1).

demos.title: Add product resource
demos.description: Add a Product resource to the mini-ERP API: POST /products (name, sku, unitPrice) and GET /products/{id}. Persist in memory. Update openapi.yaml and add contract tests for the new operations.

demos.title: Add customer resource
demos.description: Add a Customer resource to the mini-ERP API: POST /customers (name, email) and GET /customers/{id}. Persist in memory. Update openapi.yaml and add contract tests for the new operations.
